title: Splash animation triggers game crash
description: Verify that playing the splash animation causes the game to crash as intended.
steps_actions:
1. "Launch the game."
2. "Observe the splash animation start."
3. "Wait for the animation to complete."
steps_result:
1. "Game process starts."
2. "Splash animation appears on screen."
3. "Game process terminates unexpectedly (crash) after animation ends."

title: Disable splash animation prevents crash
description: Verify that disabling the splash animation prevents the crash.
steps_actions:
1. "Launch the game with splash animation disabled via configuration."
2. "Observe game startup."
steps_result:
1. "Game starts without showing splash animation."
2. "Game runs normally without crashing."

title: Partial splash animation does not crash before completion
description: Verify that interrupting the splash animation before it finishes does not cause a crash.
steps_actions:
1. "Launch the game."
2. "When splash animation starts, press Escape to skip it."
3. "Observe the game state after skipping."
steps_result:
1. "Game starts and splash animation begins."
2. "Splash animation is skipped."
3. "Game continues to main menu without crashing."
